component.name: Header
component.description: Top app header with an always-visible user avatar, personalized greeting, notifications, and rewards entry points.

antiPatterns.scenario: Checkout, onboarding, or modal critical flows
antiPatterns.reason: The header adds navigation exits and visual noise.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use a focused flow header or no header.

rules: Header must compose Avatar and IconButton instances instead of drawing their internals.
Header exposes only semantic tokens and layout primitives; child component tokens belong to Avatar and IconButton metadata.
Default notifications: Icon `notifications` (tone secondary); unread state uses **IconButton `badge`** (brand pink via `component/iconButton/badge/*`), separate from the glyph.
Default header icons (`present`, `notifications`, `notificationsBadge`) use Icon **tone secondary**; pass custom nodes via `rewardsIcon` / `notificationIcon` to override.
Avatar/User is always visible in the Header MVP.
Greeting text uses Label typography: regular for ¡Hola and bold for the display name (see docs/components/header.md and docs/foundations/figma-musky-contract.md).

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Avatar and icon actions are native buttons when interactive.
accessibility.screenReader: Icon-only buttons require aria-label. Notification count is announced in the notification button label.
accessibility.focusManagement: Focus order is Avatar/User, Rewards, Notifications. Header references semantic/focus/ring; Avatar and IconButton manage their own component-level focus aliases. The badge does not receive focus.

aiHints.context: Use at the top of authenticated app screens. Do not use in focused full-screen flows.
